# gws recipe: Create a Shared Drive

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the create-shared-drive recipe: create a Google Shared Drive and add members with appropriate roles — with the real API subtleties documented (idempotent `requestId`, `supportsAllDrives` on permission calls, then list members to verify). No equivalent in lots 31-33 (the lot 31 Drive recipes are about files, not shared drives). By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: requires the `gws` binary and a Google account (browser OAuth is free; Shared Drives generally need a paid Google Workspace account); the `gws-drive` prerequisite comes from the same repo but is not listed in this catalog; install the prerequisite `googleworkspace-cli-gws-shared` first. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
